column1: # MFRAGS=4 wide-M register tile (dot habu-mma-wave-2-4d7594e7, lib/ptx/cg-mma.f MMA-MFRAGS=4): each warp owns 4 stacked 16-row M-frags so the 256x64 block reuses each 8x8 B fragment across 4 M-frags (B-side scalar feed further amortized vs MFRAGS=2). 918 MHz pinned (25W mode-3; restored to as-found 408 after); same-session refs reproduce shipped MM 981914/982012, MMM-SWZ-BK64 1369811/1369984, MMM-WIDE-M2 2133691/2132844 within 0.1%, so the pin equals the shipped clock and these are directly comparable to Triton 1890500. Two runs at 2048^3 within 0.09%; mma-gemm-check element-exact at 256^3 AND 512^3 (65536+262144 cells, ldmatrix AND scalar+cvt cross-check). SINGLE-BUFFER STATIC (49152 B = the 48KiB cap, higher occupancy) BEATS double-buffer dynamic (98304 B, 1 block/SM) because the 4x B-feed amortization re-weights the roofline toward mma-issue, so cp.async overlap matters less: 2707287 = 1.269x MMM-WIDE-M2 2133944 (best prior), +26.9% over parity, 1.43x Triton. DCE-safe ablation (tools/ptx/mma-ablate.f) at the winner: B-feed 51.4/190.3 ms = 27% (down from 36% at MFRAGS=2), 2nd-4th-M-frag mma-issue 60.4/190.3 ms = 32% (up from 15%) - now the DOMINANT residual (own quarter-B ceiling 3711 GFLOP/s, 73% attained). Next lever is the device-proven B-side ldmatrix (tools/ptx/mma-probe.f MP-BLDM-ALL, transposed-Bs ldmatrix.x2, element-exact) to cut the 27% B-feed; the mma-issue 32% is tensor-core-throughput-bound.

column1: # fp16 transposed-Bs B feed (dot habu-fp16-transposed-bs, lib/ptx/cg-mma.f MMA-BTF16=1): Bs stored TRANSPOSED (n-major BT[n][k], K contiguous) so each B register loads as ONE ld.shared.b32 instead of two ld.shared.u16 + shift/or - the fp16 analogue of the tf32 wave-3 B-ldmatrix feed. cp.async cannot gather the transpose, so BT is a scalar transposed u16 copy (coalesced global read, strided shared write) while As stays cp.async; BT row stride BK+BPAD halves, BPAD=8 conflict-free (b32 start-bank stride 20).
